name: parcel-toolkit-apc
description: Book, label, track and cancel APC Overnight parcels by asking Claude. It uses your own APC account, runs on your computer and talks straight to APC.

apc_username.title: APC account email
apc_username.description: The email you use to log in to the APC portal. Your account needs API access.

apc_password.title: APC account password
apc_password.description: The password you use to log in to the APC portal. Claude Code keeps it in your computer's secure storage.
